Container.Name: handoff
Container.Overview:
Handoff turns a file or folder on your server into a shareable download link with an expiry date.
Pick a folder from your array and Handoff zips it once and serves it; pick a single file and it is served in place with no copy. Or drag a file into the browser to upload it. Every link can carry an expiry, an optional password, and an optional download limit. When a link expires the link and any archive Handoff created are deleted automatically — files on your shares are never modified or removed.
Downloads support HTTP range requests, so a 40GB archive survives a dropped connection and resumes instead of restarting. Meant to sit behind your existing reverse proxy.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: share link file transfer download expiring url shortener send wetransfer
Container.Requires: A reverse proxy if you want links to work outside your LAN.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port for the Handoff web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, uploads, and generated zip archives live here. Put it somewhere with room for the largest archive you plan to share.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: The files you want to be able to share, mounted read-only. Point it at a single share (for example /mnt/user/Photos) if you would rather not browse everything.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the upload interface. Minimum 8 characters — the container will not start without it. Download links are separate and do not need this.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional. The outside address of this app, for example https://share.example.com. Set it so the links you copy are the ones your recipients can actually open.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as.
